fleet.title: Fleet
fleet.subtitle: Vehicles registered for marketplace matching and bids.
fleet.capabilitiesSubtitle: Specialized equipment and certifications supported across your fleet.
fleet.pendingReviewHint: New vehicles stay Pending review until Super Admin approves the RWC. You can still bid with other Active vehicles.
fleet.addVehicleHint: Enter class, GVM, tare, and optional GCM from the compliance plate, and upload the official Roadworthy / Certificate of Inspection (RWC / COI) for each registered unit. After company approval, new vehicles need Super Admin review before bids.
fleet.editVehicleHint: Update label, registration, class, mass ratings, and finish any missing unit RWC / COI files. Class and masses cannot change while this vehicle is on an active trip.
fleet.editCapacityLocked: This vehicle is on an active trip. You can still update label and registration; change class or masses after reassign or complete.
fleet.rwcHint: Official state/NHVR safety certificate only (e.g. VIC RWC, QLD COI, NSW HVIS) — not a private mechanic report. Required for bidding.
fleet.editRwcHint: Upload any incomplete unit certificates here (e.g. Trailer 2 on a B-double). Units already OK can optionally be replaced.
fleet.rwcRequiredError: Select an RWC / COI file before adding the vehicle.
fleet.rwcRequiredOnEditError: Select an RWC / COI file for the powered unit — current upload is incomplete.
fleet.rwcUploadSuccess: RWC / COI uploaded for this unit.
fleet.rwcMissingBanner: One or more vehicles are missing a valid RWC / COI on every required unit. Upload per unit before bidding or reactivate.
fleet.multiUnitHint: Articulated combinations need a registration and RWC / COI for the prime mover and each trailer.
fleet.unitRwcRequired: Select an RWC / COI file for {{unit}}.
fleet.unitRwcNeedsUpload: {{unit}} status: {{state}} — upload required to complete this combination.
fleet.unitRwcReplaceHint: Leave empty to keep the current certificate, or choose a file to replace it.
fleet.gvmKgHint: Gross Vehicle Mass from the compliance plate. Suggested from class — edit if different.
fleet.tareKgHint: Unladen mass. Must be less than GVM.
fleet.gcmKgHint: Gross Combination Mass from the compliance plate (optional). Must be greater than or equal to GVM when set.
fleet.vehicleCapabilitiesHint: These flags update your company capabilities (not stored per vehicle). Manage the full set above.
fleet.capDgHint: Requires an active DG licence document
fleet.toggleCapsHint: Turn on equipment and load types your fleet can handle:
fleet.vehicleHasDg: This vehicle is licensed for Dangerous Goods (DG)
fleet.dgDocHint: Required to bid this vehicle on Dangerous Goods jobs (document or image).
fleet.dgDocRequiredError: Please upload the Dangerous Goods (DG) document for this vehicle.
fleet.emptyHint: Add your first vehicle here to get your fleet ready for bidding.
fleet.disableBody: Suspend {{rego}} from bidding. You need at least one other active vehicle if you are bid-eligible.
fleet.retireBody: Retire {{rego}} permanently from the active fleet.
fleet.deleteBody: Permanently remove {{rego}}? Only allowed if it has never been used on a bid or assignment. Otherwise disable or retire it instead.
fleet.reactivateBody: Return {{rego}} to active fleet status? A valid (non-expired) RWC / COI is required for every combination unit.
fleet.toolbarSearchPlaceholder: Search by registration, label, or class…
fleet.emptyFilteredHint: Try clearing the search or filter to see your full fleet.

cause.RWC_EXPIRED: Roadworthy / Certificate of Inspection (RWC / COI) expired on a unit — upload a valid certificate to clear.
cause.SERVICE_INTERVAL: Service interval reached — log a service to clear.
cause.SAFETY_FAIL: Safety check failed — log a service once resolved to clear.
cause.MANUAL: Manually flagged for maintenance — log a service once resolved to clear.

fleetAnalytics.title: Fleet+ Analytics
fleetAnalytics.subtitle: Profit, utilisation, and flagged vehicles across your active fleet.
fleetAnalytics.emptyTitle: No fleet activity in this period.
fleetAnalytics.emptyHint: Analytics populate once vehicles complete locked/completed assignments.

fleetPlus.complimentaryBanner: Fleet+ is included free on this platform (subscription billing is off).
fleetPlus.notEntitledBody: Unlock profit per trip, utilisation tracking, and maintenance flags with Fleet+. Start your 14-day free trial — no card required.
fleetPlus.startTrialBody: Unlock profit analytics, cost tracking, and maintenance alerts for your fleet.
fleetPlus.trialDaysLeft: {{days}} day(s) left in your Fleet+ trial.
fleetPlus.activeStatusBanner: Fleet+ is active on this account.
fleetPlus.costServiceHint: Used to calculate profit per trip and maintenance alerts.
fleetPlus.costProfileRateHint: Used by smart allocation to rank "Most profitable".
fleetPlus.logServiceHint: Record an odometer reading for {{rego}}. If this vehicle is in maintenance for a service interval or safety check, you can clear it below.
fleetPlus.notesPlaceholder: e.g. Oil + filter change, brake inspection
fleetPlus.clearMaintenanceLabel: Clear MAINTENANCE status for this vehicle

suggestions.title: Smart suggestions
suggestions.hint: Tap a suggestion to assign that vehicle.

adminVehicleClasses.freightRatesTitle: Freight rates (AUD, ex-GST guidance → Ops quote)
adminVehicleClasses.freightRatesHint: Active rates drive job estimates and bid floors for this class. Guidance min/max are shown to senders as a range.
adminVehicleClasses.title: Vehicle Classes
adminVehicleClasses.subtitle: Manage vehicle hierarchy, cargo envelopes, licence classes, and per-class freight rates ($/km · $/hr). Sender estimates and bid floors use these rates.
adminVehicleClasses.hierarchyRuleHint: Auto-suggestion evaluates active classes in order of Rank: selects the lowest rank where cargo weight and dimensions (L×W×H) both fit.
adminVehicleClasses.emptyDesc: Add a new vehicle class or wait for automatic initialization.
adminVehicleClasses.deleteConfirmBody: If this vehicle class is referenced by existing vehicles or jobs, deletion will be blocked and you can deactivate it instead.
adminVehicleClasses.confirmActivateDesc: Activating this vehicle class will make it immediately available for sender auto-suggestion and carrier fleet registration.
adminVehicleClasses.confirmDeactivateDesc: Deactivating this vehicle class will hide it from sender load auto-suggestion and prevent carriers from selecting it for new fleet vehicles.
adminVehicleClasses.confirmCreateDesc: This will add the new vehicle class to the marketplace sizing hierarchy.
adminVehicleClasses.confirmEditDesc: Updates to dimensions, payload, and rank will immediately affect auto-suggestion for new jobs.
adminVehicleClasses.modalSubtitle: Configure load thresholds and dimension limits for auto-suggestion.
adminVehicleClasses.codeHintEdit: Code cannot be changed once created
adminVehicleClasses.rankHint: 1 = smallest (e.g. Ute); larger can take smaller jobs
adminVehicleClasses.cargoBayDesc: Used by auto-suggestion so large/bulky items trigger a vehicle class with sufficient cargo envelope.
adminVehicleClasses.gvmHint: Default GVM when carrier selects this class
adminVehicleClasses.tareHint: Default Tare when carrier selects this class
adminVehicleClasses.activeCheckLabel: Active (Available for sender auto-suggestion and carrier fleet registration)
adminVehicleClasses.errCodeFormat: Code must contain only uppercase letters, numbers, and underscores.
